profile.headline: Experienced Software Solution Architect with a focus on multi-cloud engineering and DevOps | AWS | Microsoft Azure | Google Cloud | Oracle Cloud
profile.summary:
Software Solution Architect with over 13 years of experience specializing in multi-cloud engineering and DevOps. Skilled in designing and implementing scalable, high-performance solutions across AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, and Oracle Cloud. Passionate about driving innovation, optimizing system performance, and delivering business value through cutting-edge technologies.

Track record of leading and coordinating software development projects across diverse sectors, encompassing solution architecture design, digital content distribution platform development, legacy payment system restructuring, business/web applications creation, and logistics system design. Senior DevOps Engineer offering a history of deploying/maintaining cloud-based infrastructure (AWS, Azure), creating CI/CD pipelines, and executing security protocols and access controls while continuously optimizing systems’ performance and resource utilization. Background in managing all front-end and back-end development aspects involving user interface creation, database management, API development, and server-side programming. Adept at improving product quality and ensuring timely project execution while applying Agile and Scrum methodologies. Problem-solving skills with an ability to foster stakeholder relationships to provide solutions for resolving complex issues. Bilingual with proficiency in English and French.


TECHNICAL SKILLS
Web Development: HTML5, CSS/Sass, XML, Bootstrap, JavaScript/TypeScript - JQuery, Angular (7, 14 & 17), Node.js, JSON, Express, React-Native, ASP.Net, ASP Classic, Blazor, GraphQL, Redux & Hooks, MVC Razor Views (including Filters, Validations, and Routing), RESTful and SOAP web services (WCF, Web API), MongoDB

Programming Languages: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) with C# .NET, Python, and Go
Software Development: Unified Modeling Language (UML), Containerization, CI/CD, Test-Driven Development (TDD) with VS Unit and Visual Studio versions, SOLID principles, Domain-Driven Design, Clean Architecture, and Microservice Design, Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF), Code Refactoring

Data Access & Databases: NET Data Access (ADO.NET and LINQ to SQL), Relational Databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, T-SQL), NoSQL Databases (MongoDB, Redis)
Development Methodologies: Agile, Scrum, and SDLC
Networking: Penetration Testing

Cloud Services & DevOps: AWS, Azure, Digital Ocean, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Vagrant, Bash Scripting

Distributed Application Runtime:	DAPR, RabbitMQ

Learn more about my portfolio at - https://medium.com/@nanabrown.agyir

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead a team of software engineers in the modernization of Caret Legal’s legacy legal practice management platform. Oversee full-stack development and DevOps practices to rebuild critical systems, transitioning from legacy ASP Forms to a modern microservices-based architecture using .NET 7 and Angular 17.

positions.title: Senior .NET & Golang Engineer Consultant
positions.description:
As a Senior Full-Stack and DevOps Engineering Consultant, I design, develop, and maintain scalable back-end services and CI/CD pipelines. I collaborate with quality assurance and operations teams to optimize development processes and translate high-level architectural designs into production-ready software applications within Agile environments, ensuring seamless implementation and project success.

Key Achievements & Responsibilities:

• Cloud Infrastructure & Architecture: Designed and deployed fault-tolerant infrastructure solutions and applications leveraging Azure Cloud services, including Azure Key Vault, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Docker containers, Azure Service Bus, Dapr, and Azure App Services.

• Innovation & Proof-of-Concept Development: Pioneered a Proof-of-Concept (PoC) for a profile management system utilizing Azure, APM, and SAML authentication protocols.

• DevOps Operations & Governance: Established organization-wide DevOps operations, including pipeline policies, merge strategies, and code quality standards to ensure best practices across development teams.

• Security & Compliance: Authored and implemented enterprise-level Privileged Access Group (PAG) and Privileged Identity Management (PIM) policies, enforcing security standards through Infrastructure as Code (IaC) methodologies.

As a Senior Consultant and Software Engineer, I have delivered solutions for multiple clients through Cerebral Labs, including:
positions.insights: Skills: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · .NET Core · ASP.NET Core · Azure DevOps Server · DOCKER · Programming · Web Development · Dapr · GraphQL · Full-Stack Development · Kubernetes · AngularJS · MediatR · Microsoft SQL Server · .NET · Microsoft Azure · ASP.NET MVC · Entity Framework · Angular · Software Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Senior Dotnet Developer
positions.description: Act as a Full-Stack and Multi-cloud DevOps Engineer to develop, evaluate, and maintain back-end services and CI / CD pipelines. Improve the development processes in collaboration with quality assurance and operations teams. Translate high-level architectural designs into software applications in an Agile environment to ensure seamless implementation and project success.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering III
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
At CARET Legal, I serve as a Senior Software Engineer III, part of a team tasked with modernization of the company’s legacy .NET 3.0 and KnockoutJS platform into a .NET 7  microservices-based architecture. My work focuses on scalability, maintainability, and performance optimization across the enterprise legal-tech ecosystem.

Key contributions include:

Architecting and implementing cloud-ready microservices and APIs to replace legacy monolithic components.
Migrating existing modules from KnockoutJS to Angular with improved UI performance and cleaner component structure.
Introducing DevOps best practices—CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and containerized deployments—to streamline development and delivery.
Mentoring and coaching junior engineers, fostering best practices in clean code, SOLID principles, and test-driven development.
Collaborating cross-functionally with product managers, QA, and operations to ensure successful releases and continuous improvement.

This role allows me to bridge architecture, engineering leadership, and DevOps to drive CARET Legal’s transformation toward a modern, scalable, and secure software platform.

positions.title: Senior .NET & Golang Engineer
positions.description:
Managed the development and deployment of a content-selling platform for MTN Global subscribers across Liberia, Guinea-Bissau, and Cameroon while leading a team of seven engineers. Managed software development lifecycle while coordinating requirement analysis, workload estimation, and release management in an Agile environment. Delivered actionable insights and solutions to high-level executives and stakeholders based on extensive data analysis. 

●	Achieved significant user adoption with 300,000+ sign-ups in the first month after the successful launch of the content-selling platform. 
●	Enhanced communication capabilities by integrating SMS, USSD, and Web channels into a new platform.
●	Ensured efficient monitoring and operations of cloud infrastructure using Azure DevOps, Pipelines, and Elastic.
positions.insights: Skills: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Full-Stack Development · PostgreSQL · REST APIs · MediatR · .NET · Microsoft Azure

projects.title: User Migration into AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM)
projects.description:
I addressed a real-world scenario as a Cloud Specialist tasked with migrating over 1000 users of our client's organization, onto their newly acquired AWS platform, specifically leveraging AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) resources.

The task required migrating these users and enabling Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) on their accounts as a security best practice. While the straightforward approach would be to create each user manually in the AWS Management Console, this is inefficient and impractical in modern organizations. Automating this process was essential to avoid repetitive tasks and human errors.
